senses.gloss: vailāsikā, velā˚ (cf. Skt. vilāsinī, ˚nikā), a concubine: Jento … ˚kāye putro Mv 〔i.348.13〕; similarly 〔349.2, 14〕; taṃ yugyayānakavigata (so v.l., metr. required) ceṭīvelāsikāhi (v.l. ˚vailā˚) ca upetaṃ 〔ii.37.5〕 (vs); bhāryāyo anupravrajetsuḥ kaḥ punar vādo anyāye velāsikāye janatāye 〔iii.223.2〕.
? Vailmavegarudra (pw Bailma˚, connecting with Skt. bilma), n. of some heretical ascetic sect (prob. corrupt): (divasanirīkṣakā … dīkṣante, read dīkṣyante) ˚rudreṣu nagnaśravaṇeṣu ca Kv 〔81.8〕.
